## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in TILE.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Benchmark or fixture
- [ ] Internal refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `pnpm check`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I preserved automatic TILE round-trip compatibility or documented the intentional breaking change.
- [ ] I updated README/docs for public API, delimiter, benchmark, or harness changes.
- [ ] I updated benchmark fixtures/results when changing benchmark claims.
